name: string_manipulation
label: String Manipulation

-- String manipulation helpers
local str = "Hello, MetaBuilder!"
local upper = str:upper()
local sub = str:sub(1, 5)
local replaced = str:gsub("MetaBuilder", "World")

name: kv_operations
label: KV Store Operations
code:
-- Key-value store operations
local kv = require("metabuilder.kv")

kv.set("session:" .. user_id, json.encode(session_data), { ttl = 3600 })
local cached = kv.get("session:" .. user_id)
if cached then
    local session = json.decode(cached)
end
kv.delete("session:" .. user_id)

name: http_request
label: HTTP Request
code:
-- HTTP request via built-in client
local http = require("metabuilder.http")

local response = http.request({
    method = "POST",
    url = "https://api.example.com/webhook",
    headers = {
        ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
        ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. token
    },
    body = json.encode({ event = "user.created", data = payload }),
    timeout = 5000
})

if response.status == 200 then
    local result = json.decode(response.body)
end
